children: Coinglass data shows that if Bitcoin breaks above $83,403, cumulative short liquidations across major centralized exchanges would reach $708 million. According to ChainCatcher, if Bitcoin falls below $76,269, cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges would also reach $708 million.

title: BTC Faces $708 Million Short Liquidations Above $83,403, Coinglass Data Shows
